title: portulaca pilosa subsp. villosa
intro: Portulaca pilosa subsp. villosa, commonly known as hairy purslane, is a flowering succulent plant in the family Portulacaceae. It is native to tropical Asia and is traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-edema and analgesic effects, as well as its ability to treat wounds and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of hairy purslane include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
